items.title: Map Label Runtime Scope Test — City Region Country Continent
items.style: Keep every geographic proper name exactly as supplied. Describe locations only at the stated scope. Do not identify places as people.

source.topic: Runtime map labels for cities, regions, countries, and continents
source.source_text: A geography tour naming New Orleans in Louisiana, United States, North America; Paris in France, Europe; and Venezia in Italy, Europe. Keep the city, state or region, country, and continent names explicit.

segments.topic: New Orleans city, Louisiana region, United States country, North America continent
segments.source_text: Name these exact places in order: New Orleans, Louisiana, United States, North America. New Orleans is a city; Louisiana is a state or region; the United States is a country; North America is a continent. Treat each as a place, never a person.

segments.topic: Paris city, France country, Europe continent
segments.source_text: Name these exact places in order: Paris, France, Europe. Paris is a city; France is a country; Europe is a continent. Treat each as a place, never a person.
